faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DCPU Pudukkottai Data Analyst recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to receive the application for the DCPU Pudukkottai Data Analyst position is 30th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Data Analyst post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field from a recognized university. Previous work experience and computer knowledge are also essential.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Data Analyst position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Data Analyst post is 42 years. Specific age relaxations might apply as per government rules, which can be found in the detailed notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Data Analyst role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Data Analyst position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 18,536/-.

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates be selected for the Data Analyst position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Data Analyst role primarily involves Document Verification. Candidates are advised to ensure all their documents are in order.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for the DCPU Pudukkottai Data Analyst jobs?
faq.answer: The application process for the DCPU Pudukkottai Data Analyst recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form, fill it, and send it via post.

faq.question: Q8. How many vacancies are available for the Data Analyst post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Data Analyst post in the District Child Protection Unit Pudukkottai.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required to be submitted with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of required documents, including a photograph, signature, ID proof, and relevant certificates, as specified in the official notification.

faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the District Child Protection Unit Pudukkottai, which is https://pudukkottai.nic.in/.
